content: LangGraph's native multi-agent handoff (langgraph-swarm, Command.PARENT) assumes all agents share ONE graph/process and one checkpointer -- handoff is just routing to a different node within the same state machine and database. It has no built-in support for handing off to a genuinely separate deployment with its own database/checkpointer; that requires building a custom handoff tool that performs cross-process/cross-database data transfer explicitly, rather than relying on LangGraph's in-process Command.PARENT routing.
